name: retrieval
title: Retrieval and ranking
summary: Score mean reciprocal rank on judged queries, with guards for project isolation, attribution and latency.
goal: Raise MRR on judged queries without leaking another project's documents, attributing another company's page, or exceeding the latency budget.
targetGuidance: Set the bar a small fraction of MRR above baseline; one rank improvement on a judged query is a real change.

guardDetails.completeness: Every judged query appears exactly once.
guardDetails.isolation: No ranked document belongs to another project.
guardDetails.attribution: No ranked document belongs to another company; right-company-wrong-source misses are reported in diagnostics.
guardDetails.latency: Every row is within the manifest's latency budget.
guardDetails.judgments: Hard negatives are not also judged relevant.

data.label: SAMPLE FIXTURE — replace with real judged queries and documents

knownBad.reason: The first document is a hard negative on every query, so MRR falls.
A same-company page is ranked but not the judged relevant page; MRR falls and diagnostics name the miss.
A document from another company is ranked.
A document from another project is ranked.
The query exceeds the declared latency budget.
Infinity is not a latency measurement.
A row has no ranked documents.

repeats.why: The adapter is deterministic; repeat real candidate runs to measure noise.

notes: The right-company-wrong-source case is a quality miss, not a contract violation. Keep it in the judged set so the score cannot hide it.
